serverInfo.name: yume-mcp
serverInfo.title: Yume
serverInfo.description: MCP server over Yume's real catalog, FAQ and blog (custom vinyl and logo stickers, personalized party favor boxes, Google-review NFC/QR plates and stands, medical prescription pads; Guadalajara, Jalisco, shipping across Mexico), plus ordering tools: exact price quotes, pre-filled cart links and checkout links paid by the customer on Mercado Pago. Content tools accept lang=es (default) or lang=en.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: List Yume's full catalog with real starting prices in MXN.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail for one product by slug (ES or EN): price tiers, specs, FAQ, shipping and orderGuide (option ids, piece minimums, personalization fields).

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Exact checkout price for a set of items, with home-delivery and Guadalajara pickup totals and a cart link.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Link that opens Yume's cart pre-filled with the items; the customer adds shipping details and pays on the site.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: With the customer's consent and contact/delivery details, create a pending order and return a Mercado Pago payment link the customer opens to pay. Nothing is charged by the call.

tools.name: get_pickup_branches
tools.description: Casa Blanca pickup branches in the Guadalajara metro area (ids for create_checkout).

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Search Yume's FAQ across all products.

tools.name: get_blog_post_detail
tools.description: Full content of one blog post by slug.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: WhatsApp link to request a quote, personalized to a product or blog topic.
